items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Harley goes to the airline highway back there, across the airline highway, Bahamut and Street.

ctx.x: And you sold the white for Shane? I used to have some cases in here between here and the airline highway going back to this. You see, I used to go back, walk back, Harley goes to the airline highway back there, across the airline highway, Bahamut and Street. And I used to pick up a few collections in here, you know, some white families have insurance in here, but gradually they all left for the camera. I've been retired from Shane for three years, you know, almost three years. And towards the end there, there was…
Well what was in Shrewsbury then?
